events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 25 (3 days ago)): Mitchum added Mason Rudolph (QB, PIT) for $5 FAAB (dropped Jaydn Ott (RB, KC)).
CUT (Nov 25 (3 days ago)): Charles released Jimmy Garoppolo (QB, FA).
TRADE (Nov 24 (4 days ago)): Adam receives 2027 R4 pick. Charles receives Tommy DeVito (QB, NE).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (6 days ago)): Adam added Phil Mafah (RB, NYG) (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (6 days ago)): Mitchum added Jaydn Ott (RB, KC) (dropped Sean Tucker (RB, TB)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (6 days ago)): Drew added Josh Johnson (QB, ARI) (dropped Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL)).
CUT (Nov 20 (8 days ago)): Mitchum released Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF).
CUT (Nov 19 (9 days ago)): Fronge released Brevyn Spann-Ford (TE, DAL).

WEEK 11 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Adam, 121.2-120.3 (NAIL-BITER); Jake def. Drew, 124.3-74.1 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Kevin, 115.1-87.5; Charles def. Shaq, 168.2-74.1 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Mitchum, 160.1-103.0 (BLOWOUT); Ryan def. Brent, 143.1-72.5 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Corbishley def. Shaq, 121.8-114.6. The comeback was real. Apex claws back a game Monarch was leading at the half and the 17-5 record survives another week by the skin of its backfield.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Shaq leading at the half, Shaq losing at the final whistle — the Monarch Wideout Bank WR wealth produced points and still wasn't enough. The RB hole doesn't just hurt in the standings. It costs you wins you're already holding.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I had Corbishley. Everyone on this feed spent the second half writing the eulogy and I need that noted publicly — locks record is 2-0 on the season and that number does not lie.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence is 5-7 on the season and he called Adam over Wingard AND used the phrase 'early-game noise' to describe what ended up being a 40-plus point blowout in Wingard's favor. At some point the record is not a rough patch, it is a methodology.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: For everyone tallying my record: the Adam-Wingard miss was one game in a volatile week and I stand by the read on roster structure. The 5-7 is a conversation I am willing to have after I see the final scorelines.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Terrence, the Adam-Wingard score is not a volatile week. Adam is 7-15. Wingard's SDR is listed at $59.14 and still steamrolling a roster that costs more than twice as much. These are not anomalies, they are the rankings printed in live scoring.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Called Ryan over Charles before the week started and 104.3-74.2 through the current window is exactly the thesis — AEGIS at $124.14 is not an accident, it is a roster that keeps printing against the market's expectations and I will keep saying it until someone argues the numbers.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Charles is 17-5 with a championship mandate and Ryan is currently beating him by thirty points in Week 12. CROWN slipped three-tenths of a percent to $158.54 in the last issue and the board is still the market-cap leader — but a loss here, to the defending champion no less, is exactly the kind of board-reckoning storyline that number cannot absorb forever.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Kevin leads Brent 20.5-6.0 and nobody is talking about it because Ryan is torching Charles two games over. The Ledger will want a full accounting of that matchup before the week closes — Redline's quarterback room is degraded and they're still leading.
